name: com.dreamtech.uicore
description: Modular UI framework for uGUI — no third-party dependency (UniTask optional). Plug-in animation & behavior modules via Inspector, polished card-based editor with edit-mode previews. Includes AnimatedButton, AnimatedToggle, AdvancedProgressBar, ButtonFeedback (press feedback for existing uGUI buttons: shared profiles, scroll-aware presses, sound/haptic cue hook, inspector with checks, in-scene preview and a scale-over-time graph), PressScaleModule (the same squeeze for AnimatedButton) and virtual scrolling (VirtualListView / VirtualGridView: recycling, measured sizes, snapping, nested scroll, edit-mode preview editor).
